decisions.reason: Product A's strong government adoption and close fit with the firm's existing passenger data and security integration capabilities make it highly likely to be kept.
The travel health API builds less on the firm's core security and investigation knowledge and shows no quantified traction, so the firm is likely to drop it.
Cyber security awareness training leverages the firm's security expertise but is a training service rather than a core security product, so it is kept with moderate risk.
Behaviour analysis security system is closely aligned with the firm's investigation and security know-how, enabling effective learning and improvement, so it is kept.
Passenger security profiling method draws directly on the firm's security profiling and risk assessment capabilities, so it is retained.
Travel and document verification web platform is a natural extension of the firm's security and verification activities with its own market page, so it is kept.
